tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page background behind cards: the admin app backdrop and the storefront section ground.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, table rows, product tiles, inputs.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Table headers, segmented-control track, progress track, disabled inputs, image placeholders.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Row and menu-item hover wash on surface.

tokens.name: surface-strong
tokens.usage: The emphasised dark bar: the storefront sticky box bar and toasts. Dark in both themes.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: card borders, table row dividers, section rules. Decorative only.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, checkboxes, secondary buttons): 3:1 on surface and canvas in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and the primary (Shopify-style) button fill. Text on canvas, surface, surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: help text, table meta, axis labels, captions. On canvas, surface, surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Placeholder text and strikethrough compare-at prices. On canvas and surface only.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an ink fill (the primary button).

tokens.name: on-strong
tokens.usage: Text and icons on surface-strong.

tokens.name: on-strong-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on surface-strong (the compare-at total, the item count).

tokens.name: max
tokens.usage: Max Orange, the brand. FILL only: the hot CTA, tier progress, the active nav marker, the brand tile. Never as text on light grounds.

tokens.name: on-max
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a max fill. Always ink, never white (white on max fails contrast).

tokens.name: max-strong
tokens.usage: Orange as TEXT: savings amounts, the unlocked-tier label, low-stock lines, links. On surface, canvas, max-soft.

tokens.name: max-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind max-strong text: savings callouts, selected choice cards, brand badges.

tokens.name: pop
tokens.usage: Deal-sticker yellow: Save X% stickers, Best value tags, countdown chips. Fill only, with on-pop text.

tokens.name: on-pop
tokens.usage: Text on a pop fill.

tokens.name: win
tokens.usage: Success as text and icons: Active status, tier unlocked, positive deltas. On surface, canvas, win-soft. Always paired with a word or check icon.

tokens.name: win-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind win text: success badges and notices.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Warning as text and icons: Scheduled ending soon, low stock. On surface, canvas, warn-soft. Always paired with a word or icon.

tokens.name: warn-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind warn text.

tokens.name: alert
tokens.usage: Errors, destructive actions, negative deltas, Out of stock. On surface, canvas, alert-soft. Always paired with a word or icon.

tokens.name: alert-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind alert text: error notices, destructive confirm.

tokens.name: on-alert
tokens.usage: Text on an alert fill (the danger button).

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Informational text and icons: tips, onboarding notices. On surface, canvas, info-soft.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind info text.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, offset 2px. At least 3:1 on canvas, surface and surface-sunken in both themes.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Data series 1 (this period / the hero series). Marks only, never text.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Data series 2. Marks only, never text.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Data series 3. Marks only, never text. Below 3:1 on light surface: always ship with direct labels or the table view.

tokens.name: chart-muted
tokens.usage: De-emphasised series: previous period, sparkline history.

tokens.name: chart-grid
tokens.usage: Chart gridlines and axes: 1px solid, recessive.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Overlay behind drawers and modals.

styles.name: display-lg

styles.name: body-sm

styles.usage: Help text, table meta, secondary lines.

styles.name: label

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Step counters and tiny section kickers. Uppercase via CSS.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: StatCard values and the one hero figure per view. Proportional figures.

styles.name: price

styles.name: price-lg
styles.usage: The box total in BoxPanel and BoxSummaryBar.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Shortcodes, hook names, REST routes in admin help.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, buttons at sm size, thumbnails inside slots.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, segmented controls, notices.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, product tiles, choice cards, box slots.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Drawers, the sticky box bar, storefront panels.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Badges, stickers, toggles, progress bars.
